Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM and ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ivanti Neurons for ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does n” rather than ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus's shape. Choose ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid-market ITSM — Cloud Standard from $13/technician/mo; free up to 5 techs Standard; ” rather than Ivanti Neurons for ITSM's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is shaped for Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No whereas ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus is shaped for SMB/mid-market ITSM — Cloud Standard from $13/technician/mo; free up t. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM and ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Ivanti Neurons / Service Manager) — contact sales. No public list. Does not outrank ServiceNow 8.7 / Freshservice 8.4.; ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus is SMB/mid-market ITSM — Cloud Standard from $13/technician/mo; free up to 5 techs Standard; Professional $27; Enterprise $67; 30-day trial. Do.
- Company-size focus: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM (mid-market, enterprise) vs ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM — No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU; ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus — Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4).

Limitations — Ivanti Neurons for ITSM: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4); ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus: Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4); Enterprise $67 is a large step vs the $13 Standard floor — module depth gates by edition.

Poor-fit cases: Ivanti Neurons for ITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve price — $95 is a low-confidence third-party named-agent estimate, not an Ivanti SKU · ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7) or Freshservice (8.4) · Avoid Ivanti Neurons for ITSM if you actually need ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus's motion (SMB/mid-market ITSM — Cloud Standard from $13/technician/mo; free up to 5 techs )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
